newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans and meal turn higher on Brazil rumor.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans and meal turn higher on Brazil rumor.

text.p: CBOT soybean and soymeal futures turned higher near midday and the July contract was in fast dealings on talk Brazil planned to tax exports of soybeans and soymeal, pit sources said.
"There's a rumor going around about an export tax out of Brazil," a trader said.
But Brazil's agricultural ministry in March said it would be opposed to a tax and it would be rejected if proposed.
"It is politically absurd and unviable," Favio Pereira, adviser at the ministry's Agricultural Policy Secretariat said in March. "The Agriculture Ministry is opposed to the idea, clearly opposed."
At 1202 CDT, soybeans were up one cent per bushel to down six with July up one at $8.89-1/2 after dropping earlier in the session to $8.82.
Soymeal was up $0.80 per ton to down $2.50 with July up $0.20 at $290.00.
